units.name: heptabao-authbus-installed-qa-efed46d1e85c-1.service
units.unitText:
[Unit]
Description=HeptaBao AuthBus single-owner inbox coordinator
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target
ConditionPathExists=/home/qian/heptabao-authbus-installed-entry-20261104-r1/live-system-r5/installation-a/installation.private.json
ConditionPathExists=/home/qian/heptabao-authbus-installed-entry-20261104-r1/live-system-r5/installation-a/binding-pin.env

[Service]
User=qian
Group=qian
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/home/qian/heptabao-authbus-installed-entry-20261104-r1/live-system-r5/code
UMask=0077
EnvironmentFile=/home/qian/heptabao-authbus-installed-entry-20261104-r1/live-system-r5/installation-a/binding-pin.env
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B /home/qian/heptabao-authbus-installed-entry-20261104-r1/live-system-r5/code/authbus_coordinator_installed.py service serve --binding /home/qian/heptabao-authbus-installed-entry-20261104-r1/live-system-r5/installation-a/installation.private.json --binding-sha256 ${HEPTABAO_BINDING_SHA256}
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
RestartPreventExitStatus=2 3
TimeoutStopSec=15s
KillMode=control-group
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateUsers=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=read-only
ReadOnlyPaths=/home/qian/heptabao-authbus-installed-entry-20261104-r1/live-system-r5/code /home/qian/heptabao-authbus-installed-entry-20261104-r1/live-system-r5/installation-a
ReadWritePaths=/home/qian/heptabao-authbus-installed-entry-20261104-r1/live-system-r5/owner-state-a
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
